body: ac-00.5 int8 quantisation probe: candle quantized BERT (gguf or manual q8) latency vs 10ms — the lever to clear the budget comfortably + cut the ~5.8h corpus low-band pass, before committing to ac-01 fine-tune. fp32 batched is only AT budget (10.6ms).

TOP BUILD RISK (surfaced by ac-01/02 preview): mine/generate contested-residual training data — codes/abbreviations that are plain_text in context (PA, Si, EW, ISSUED). The current distilled+generator residual class doesn't cover them, so a MiniLM head trained on distilled still over-emits specific types (gold 0.648, below shipped). ac-01 must include header+values representation (+13pp) AND this data. Above latency (GPU-solved) and attractor (didn't reproduce) in priority.

Region vocab assembly: gold 'region' is a multi-admin catch-all — admin1 covers only 12/90 values. Need admin1 + admin2 (admin2Codes.txt, full GeoNames dump ~/datasets/geonames) + ISO-3166-2 subdivision codes for clean region labelling. Surfaces a gold-label question (is a US county 'region'?) — taxonomy-adjacent.

Region family is the encoder's weak spot (recall 0-0.33): needs targeted corpus mining of region/county columns + admin2/admin3 + ISO-3166-2 + format-robust matching (strip 'County', case-fold). Thin training (~600 membership-passing cols) + messy gold values are both causes.
Fix end-to-end gte-tiny encoder fine-tune (NaN on MPS step 1): add grad-clip + LR warmup, or train on CPU/CUDA. This is the lever to push contested 0.836 (frozen head) toward the 0.893 ceiling.

FAIR low-band-only corpus-honest re-test: v19_gated.parquet has null sense_confidence, so the ac-04 gate could only run the STRICT every-contested-column escalation (NO-GO, over-emits residual). Capture confidence (re-run a corpus pass on the 33k stratified sample recording sense_confidence, or re-profile contested cols) -> escalate ONLY quality_band<0.70 -> re-run corpus_honest_gate. This is the test of the build's ACTUAL design.

Rebalance encoder training data + add residual-precision penalty: assembled set is 44% residual, teaching over-prediction of residual vs corpus distribution -> corpus-gate over-emit. Reweight toward the corpus contested residual rate; penalise demote-to-residual; re-train + re-gate.

Rebuild entity_name + residual training with CLEAN labels (root cause of ac-04 NO-GO): entity_name from Wikidata orgs/brands + dbpedia entity classes + eval entity datasets (NOT the shipped model's noisy calls); keep entity_name and word DISTINCT classes (don't collapse entity into residual); this is why the encoder over-demotes entity->word at corpus scale.
